advanced_options.description:
Accept the "Home" location nickname or choose a new name such as "Work" to group fuel stations by nickname/location.

You can create multiple nicknames/locations by using "Reconfigure" on the integration page and choosing a new nickname here.
To add stations to an existing nickname/location, just enter the nickname.
To create a trip e.g. "Trip to work" use the same nickname and multiple locations.
To add a fuel type to existing stations, select the fuel here and the station on the next screen.

For each nickname/location two "cheapest" sensors will be created. Change the fuel type below to set or change the fuel type searched for each nickname, for example "Premium Unleaded 95/98" will find the cheapest U95 or U98 for the radius of the nickname.
To exclude stations from the cheapest sensors, enter text to exclude station names containing the text, e.g. "Members only".

Visit api.nsw.gov.au, subscribe to the FuelCheck API (free) and create an app (any name) to obtain your API Key and Secret.

API and data provided by NSW Fuel Check, Tasmanian data provided by Fuel Check TAS.
user.title: Setup NSW Fuel Check

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure NSW Fuel Check
reconfigure.description: Choose whether to add a new location, add stations to an existing location, edit an existing location, manage configured stations, or delete a location.

manage_stations.title: Manage configured stations
manage_stations.description: Choose the nickname/location whose configured stations you want to manage.

manage_station.title: Select configured station
manage_station.description: Choose a configured station to edit or remove.

edit_station.title: Edit station fuels or remove station
edit_station.description: Select the fuel types to keep for this station. Tap × on a selected fuel to remove it, or use Add / change fuel types to add another fuel currently reported by FuelCheck. To remove the whole station from this location, enable Remove station.

edit_location.title: Edit existing location
edit_location.description: Choose the existing nickname/location whose settings you want to change.

edit_location_settings.title: Edit location settings
edit_location_settings.description: Change the saved location/radius, cheapest-fuel search type, or cheapest-station exclusion text. This does not add or remove favorite stations.

confirm_remove_empty_location.title: Remove empty location?
confirm_remove_empty_location.description: This is the last configured station for this nickname/location. Removing it will also remove the location device and its cheapest-price entities. Submit to confirm, or close this dialog to cancel.

delete_location.title: Delete location
delete_location.description: Choose the nickname/location to remove. All configured stations and entities belonging to that location will also be removed.

confirm_delete_location.title: Delete {location}?
confirm_delete_location.description: This will permanently remove this location, all of its configured favorite-station entities, and its cheapest-price entities. Submit to confirm, or close this dialog to cancel.

add_station_existing.title: Add station to existing location
add_station_existing.description: Choose the existing nickname/location that should receive the new station. The displayed name may be a Home Assistant device name; the integration will keep the correct stored nickname automatically.

add_station_search.title: Find station to add
add_station_search.description: Choose where and how far to search, and the fuel type used to find stations. These search choices are used only to find the station and do not change the existing location's saved cheapest-fuel settings.
